title: This and That: So, Re and Ru
label: ch:ja-this-and-that-so-re-ru
canDo: I can write so, re and ru, read words that use them, and point to things and places near me and near the listener.

payoff.summary: Read soko, soto, kore, sore and kuruma, point with kore and sore, write kuruma from memory with る in the middle, and write the three new signs once each.
payoff.note: Word before sign, every time. Each of the three signs is first SEEN inside a word taught one lesson earlier -- soko for so, kore for re, kuruma for ru -- and only then written, so every letter lesson is anchored (HL-C443) rather than building toward a later word. Two lessons separate each writing lesson from the next, and each new sign is spent at once in a second word (soto, sore) or in the review. The order so, re, ru lets sore use both of the first two signs.
